evidence: The density, crystallinity of the films, and oxygen non-stoichiometry of the films were improved with increases in the growth temperature. The volume density of the PEALD-SnO2 thin film was calculated as 5.95 g/cm3 and 6.72 g/cm3 at 150 and 350 °C, respectively, which was in accordance with the bulk density (6.95 g/cm3).
